caption: Same binary, same 50 connections, only the number of requests each connection keeps in flight changes. Throughput per server CPU second tracks wall clock throughput at every depth, so the single server thread was the bottleneck. Loopback TCP on a shared Apple M4 Pro at a 1 minute load average of 7 to 9 from other jobs, so indicative only.
